Instructions, Sales & fees, Expenses, Monthly P&L. That is all four.
Open the Sales & fees tab. One row per order.
Paste Date, Order ID, gross sales, discounts, shipping charged, sales tax collected, fees, and refunds. Net to bank fills itself in.
Open the Expenses tab. One row per purchase. Pick a category from the list.
Open the Monthly P&L tab and type the first day of the month in cell B2 (for example 2026-01-01). Every total updates.
Use real dates, not text. Type 2026-01-31 or use your local date format consistently.
Tracked as pass-through money. It is held for the state, so it is not counted as profit.
Marketplace fees, payment processing, and on-platform ads live on the Sales & fees tab so each order shows what it really paid out.
Off-platform costs live on the Expenses tab. Keep the category spelling identical to the Monthly P&L rows so the totals find them.
Copy the last row down. The formula in the Net to bank column copies with it.
Some CSV imports paste formulas as plain text. Retype the equals sign in that cell and it will calculate.
